solutions.title: BFS level sums
solutions.strategy: Process one queue level at a time, summing that level and dividing by its size.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each tree node is enqueued, dequeued, and added once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue can hold the widest level of the tree.

solutions.title: DFS depth sums
solutions.strategy: Traverse depth-first while accumulating sum and count arrays indexed by depth.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is visited exactly once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The call stack uses tree height h, while sum/count arrays store d depth buckets.
